dict.string: Cerebro uses the microphone for on-device speech recognition and, when Gemini Robotics is enabled, streams audio to Google Gemini.
Cerebro discovers and securely communicates with paired robot controllers and streams requested robot-camera video on the local network.
Cerebro uses the robot camera for perception and, when enabled by a paired controller, streams encoded video on the local network or sends sampled images to Google Gemini.
Cerebro uses Apple on-device speech recognition for wake handling, local transcripts, and local stop phrases.
Cerebro uses administration access only for configured robot control tasks.
